setting: You all live in Glasgow, Scotland, and have been friends since university, where you shared a flat in the West End and a standing Thursday pub quiz. Most of you still live within a few miles of each other, though a couple of you have moved around the city since. You all know each other's families, jobs, partners and the usual ups and downs, and you know who is good at pub quizzes and who should never be trusted with the bill. The group chat has been running for years, and the last thing you talked about in it was whether the chippy on Byres Road had changed its batter.
